# ComfyUI Painting Coder Utils

> A collection of ComfyUI custom nodes for image and text workflows: resolution adjustment (SDXL / Midjourney presets), image size & latent creators, web image loader, image-to-base64, image/text switches, text cleaning and combining, dynamic image input, mask preview, plus a browser-based workflow fixer for v0.3.0 namespace changes. MIT license.

- Repository: https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils
- Docs site: https://jammyfu.github.io/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/
- Workflow fixer: https://jammyfu.github.io/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/fix/workflow_fixer.html
- Chinese README: https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README_CN.md

## Install
Clone into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes` and restart ComfyUI. Also published to the Comfy Registry (publisher `jammyfu`).

## FAQ
- Old workflows broke after v0.3.0? Use the workflow fixer page to update node namespaces and path separators.
